description: This source file contains UI tests for the OpenClawKit project, specifically testing JSON message formats and command stability for Canvas A2 UI.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: Test suite struct for Canvas A2 UI related tests, including JSON message validation and command string stability.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that the command string raw values are consistent and as expected.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of a sample JSONL input representing version 0.8 messages.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that an unsupported 'createSurface' message in JSONL is correctly rejected.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Checks that unknown JSON object shapes are appropriately rejected during decoding.
